modelReferences.name: stylized-cabinet.glb
modelReferences.role: Reusable stylized cabinet body, doors, knobs and feet

modelReferences.name: scene.blend
modelReferences.role: Inspect stylized proportions and materials; no geometry incorporation

summary:
Created and inspected the teal cabinet with two doors, round orange knobs, four tapered orange feet, and an overhanging top.

Reused the authorized GLB geometry and refined its materials. The inspection-only .blend guided proportions and finish; none of its geometry was incorporated. All 19 mesh parts have materials and are ready for GLB export.
limitation: Real image-input cabinet trial with two local references; not an anime character aesthetic comparison or live text image-generation trial. Human final preview remains pending.
